admission.justification: Spans the leaf enclosure and task-documents: own-document-only reads as real files with a pre-first-turn INDEX entry is the D124/D125 containment mechanism; public writes refresh only the own leaf's copies.

applicability: Ordinary enclosed leaf roles reading their own rendered task document.
conditions: The copied leaf is the agent's own leaf; declared approved requirement references extend that bound file set, never another leaf.
Real JSON/Markdown files and one INDEX artifact with copied digests and explicit missing rows exist before the first turn.
Public writes rendering bound documents reconcile the exact copy set with rollback on failed publication.
exclusions: Git-tree or in-memory-only copies presented as the readable file.
Granted-direct leaf roles use their admitted master-series contract and own group/task-documents placement; this enclosure guarantee does not promise direct automatic public-write refresh.
statement: An enclosed leaf role reads its own rendered leaf document and declared approved requirements as real task-documents files, with one INDEX artifact recording copied digests and named missing files before the first turn; public writes refresh only the exact bound copy set atomically.
